newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal starts med device/tech cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal starts med device/tech cos.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it initiated coverage of five medical device/technology companies.
-- said rates i-STAT Corp a strong buy, with a price target of $25.
-- rates Hologic Inc outperform long-term, with a price target of $38.
-- rates Thermo Cardiosystems outperform long-term, with a price target of $30.
-- rates Heartstream outperform spculative, with a price target of $17.
-- rates UroMed Corp outperform speculative, with price target of $10 to $12.
-- said companies are growing, or have potential to grow, at significantly higher rates than the industry average.
-- said companies should benefit from industry trends of growing healthcare expenditures, cost containment and conolidation.
